message: 予兆

name: Synn
message: 「Alright, today's Student Council meeting is going to be a long haul. Mondays are when we decide the activity guidelines for the week.」

name: Paqy
message: 「So why are we coming to Prier?」

name: Synn
message: 「To fill our stomachs in preparation for the meeting.」

name: Paqy
message: 「You don't got the money for that, do ya?」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't worry about it. At Prier, water, hot water, tea, and sugar packets are free. Let's make some sugar water to drink for nourishment and stamina!」

name: Paqy
message: 「What are you, an insect?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Eeeeeek.\s08」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte?」
Unexpectedly, the familiar scream of my underclassman rings out from the direction of the tables.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hawawahawawa...」
When I rush over, Lolotte is standing in a daze, pointing at a banana.
It looks like she cleanly finished a cake set and polished off a dessert fruit platter too, leaving only a roughly sliced banana untouched.

name: Lolotte
message: 「P-President, it's terrible. Please look at this banana.」

name: Synn
message: 「Looks delicious.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes, it's super tasty♪」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ain't that a good thing? What're you panicking about?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Gasp?! No, please don't change the subject, Mr. Panda!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It doesn't have a banana sticker on it~. *Sniffle, sob*.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Huh? What the heck is that?」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte, you rarely ever get your hands on one of those.」
Every once in a rare while, I buy a bargain-priced bunch of clearance bananas.
Roughly one out of every ten times, one of the bananas has a tiny, thumb-sized sticker stuck on it.
I don't know if "banana sticker" is the official name, nor is it clear whether it indicates the farm of origin or is a mark from the shipping plant.

name: Paqy
message: 「Being able to understand what the angel's saying--that's Synn-sama for ya.」

name: Synn
message: 「Anyone who cooks for themselves knows about it.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Exactly. You're really no big deal either, Mr. Panda.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Says the angel who doesn't even cook her own meals, huh?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I-I-I-I am not an angel!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Slow reaction there.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Sparkle! You're interested too, President. In that case, I'll give you a special peek♪」
Lolotte looks at me with sparkling eyes and opens her guidebook. Tucked into the page she opened this time was a college-ruled notebook.

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's a collection I'm rather proud of, clap-clap.」

name: Synn
message: 「A-Amazing. Collecting this many banana stickers must have been tough.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes, my tummy is already completely stuffed.」
Stickers are neatly pasted across every page of the well-worn notebook.
Pictures, patterns, and numbers are printed on the stickers, and no two are alike.
In particular, the pictures drawn on them are so nonsensical that even someone as clueless about art as me can tell--there's no foundational sketching, no perspective, and no logic to them.

name: Lolotte
message: 「This one, this one, and this one are my favorites.」
Lolotte points out sticker after sticker. Some only have letters and numbers on them, though those don't seem to catch Lolotte's interest.
What she showed me were two angels bathing together. A witch and a young girl balancing on a ball. A princess and a knight dancing in a field.
Pictures like an anthropomorphic car guarding a house, a chicken that swallowed a spoon, and a demon strumming a harp.
I had never consciously thought about it before, but the illustrations on banana stickers are completely free-spirited, to the point that you could call each one its own little landscape.
Yet those dreamlike sights are printed within tiny spaces using naive lines and colors.

name: Lolotte
message: 「This person looks just like Jiiya, and this one is the spitting image of you, President.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, you've got a really pure sensibility, Lolotte. You feel a whole world inside each and every sticker, don't you?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Bwuh? I've never thought about it in such complicated terms, but...... I like what I like!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Whatever, man, to collect this many, you must've eaten tens of thousands of bananas, right?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Eek, I haven't eaten that many. Please don't talk about me like I'm a fully automated banana-processing machine.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The bananas served for dessert just always happened to have stickers on them.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Quit bluffing, how low do you think the odds of that are? Your butler was probably rigging it behind the scenes, wasn't he?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Tsamo!?」
An arrow flies out of nowhere and pierces Paqy. If he weren't a stuffed panda, he would have been badly injured.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh, it's a message arrow from Jiiya.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hmm, hmm... It says, 'I did not tamper with anything. This is entirely the result of your extraordinary luck, Milady.'」

name: Lolotte
message: 「And yet... thump-thump, shiver-shiver, there wasn't a sticker today. It's terrible misfortune.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It is an omen that something bad is going to happen, you know. Please be careful, President.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, got it. I'll let everyone in the Crusaders know too.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Eek! You mustn't, mustn't tell them about the banana stickers, okay? You're the very first person I've ever shown that notebook to, President.」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that so? Then I'll keep that a secret and just tell them to stay on guard.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Aah, chomp♪ Munch, munch~」

name: Paqy
message: 「Geesh! After all that talk, you're still gonna eat that banana?」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, he's back.」
In the moments it takes Lolotte to finish her last bite, I flip through the secret notebook once more.
Sharing a trivial secret that makes me feel like I've grown closer to Lolotte--
